verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm Temporal Schedules, which start Workflow Executions at specific times and are described as more flexible than the legacy Temporal Cron Jobs also listed in the docs. That covers the core of time-based workflow scheduling. The pack does not document the more advanced parts of the story. Missing for 10: explicit cron-expression syntax in Schedules, overlap policies, pause/resume of schedules, visibility into upcoming scheduled runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
